verdict.rationale: Retell documents a built-in Analytics dashboard that charts call and chat metrics such as success rate, latency, cost and concurrency, with filters and breakdowns. It also offers built-in call success and sentiment scoring, AI QA sentiment trends, and Conductor to build or improve dashboards from plain-language requests, so a founder doesn't need to build their own. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that call duration is a dashboard metric, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboards.
